correctness.rationale: Coprime multiplication preserves Zumkeller divisor partitions; seeds 2^a p are Zumkeller when p<=2^(a+1)-1, and 70 has sigma(70)=144 with divisor subset {70,2} of sum 72. For each odd p the exact valuation-one square-lift event G_p mod p^2 has size (p-1)(p+2)/2: either nonzero quadratic-residue r mod p or p|r with p^2∤r. CRT and nested binary square-residue strata give ten-prime density 63520442937841228526/83108492151210387225. Mixed 70 event N mod4∈{2,3}, N mod25∈G_5, N mod49∈G_7 has event density (1/2)*(14/25)*(27/49); its intersection with old C is only p=3 event of probability 5/9, so incremental density is 12/175. Independent exact Fraction recomputation confirmed final 2768772438842683346/3324339686048415489=0.8328789174170931; inspect verify.py counts 6804−3780=3024 classes modulo 44100. CRT chooses positive square root x<=15376 and N>15376^2 ensures z=N−x^2>0; coprime Zumkeller seeds handle both constructions. Thus every large certified residue is representable; finite prefix irrelevant to liminf. No density-one assertion.
